copy_lock.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.

The date began with one missing key
and two suspects.

By the third wrong turn,
nobody was cute anymore.

“Don’t talk to me.”

He gave her the minute.
Not the distance.

It wasn’t really the wrong turn.

They had simply missed each other
for too many ordinary days.

The plan failed.
The date didn’t.

He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.

agents.prompt_summary: Extract visual mechanics from references without copying frames, likenesses, or exact labels.
Prove every locked slide through concrete Aachu/Zuv behavior, not decorative illustration.
Define wants, hidden needs, eye-lines, hands, posture, distance, and joke-to-tenderness movement.
Plan readable text and brandmark placement independently for every request-locked native output.
Translate the selected visual system into specific final-generation and integrated-text constraints.
Select one system only after scoring copy alignment, relationship proof, visual variety, identity, aspect safety, and sendability.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Rain-damp evening beside a tiny roadside chai stall. Exactly Aachu and Zuv stand under one umbrella beside their modest dark car, safely parked on the quieter service lane away from traffic, dressed for a proper date. Across the divided road, through moving cars, the intended restaurant on the next road is visibly close but inconvenient to reach. The chai stall glows immediately beside them. Aachu points toward the chai stall with her right hand while her left hand stays relaxed at her side. Zuv holds the umbrella in his right hand and lowers the phone map in his left; they exchange a small conspiratorial 'shall we?' look. This is the decision before the accidental date, not the seated payoff. No chai vendor or background people visible.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

He still checked the lock twice.

and checked it with him.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Before departure, this nonlinear callback is entirely OUTSIDE the apartment in a pristine dry corridor. Medium-wide, straight-on full-body view. The fully closed warm-brown wooden apartment door dominates the lower frame from center-left to frame right. Its single exterior lever is on the RIGHT edge beside Zuv. Far left in the background, small and partly cropped, the elevator is already 80 percent closed: only a narrow dark seam, no cabin interior. Draw no elevator button, switch, intercom, or wall plate. Exactly two people share one depth plane, Zuv slightly taller and broader, with clear air between their torsos. Zuv stays square to the apartment door. His visible anatomical RIGHT hand wraps and depresses its exterior lever; his LEFT arm is hidden behind his back. Only Aachu turns back. Her left foot points toward the distant elevator, her lifted right heel steps toward the apartment door, and three faint ticks trace the return. Aachu stands DIRECTLY before the door's wooden center-left panel, never in the wall gap. Her anatomical RIGHT palm lands at least one handspan INSIDE the wooden door outline; uninterrupted brown wood grain surrounds every finger. Locked elbow, shoulder weight, and two short compression strokes drawn directly on the wood make a forceful push-test. Her palm must never touch any lift control, wall fixture, wall, or doorframe. Her left hand is hidden by the shoulder tote and rolled bone-dry umbrella. They never touch or overlap. Each looks at their own apartment-door contact with a small private smile. Preserve attached-reference identity and wardrobe: Aachu has a soft fuller oval-round face, mostly straight center-parted dark hair, white shirt, jeans, and red pointed flats; Zuv has a broad rounded-oval face, fuller beard, brushed-up swept dark waves rather than ringlets, pale blue embroidered shirt, loose grey trousers, and red-black shoes. Both participate in one apartment-door check through separate contacts: he tests the handle while she has gone back and pushes the wood panel. No casual palm, key, interior, open apartment door, open lift, lift-button touch, wetness, folded arms, solo checker, couple touch, scooter, motorbike, or helmets.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.
